svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Side rails: two tubes 1,000 long, 540 apart inside (600 outside).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cross members, 540 long, between the rails: front, flush with the rail

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front ends; rear, its back face 30 in from the rail back ends; middle,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 350 behind the front one, cut in three (110, 260, 110) round the bearers.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bearers: two lines of tube 260 apart inside, 320 long in front of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: middle cross member and 590 behind it, all tops flush.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Legs: 190 long under each rail's front end; a 40 mm rubber foot below.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Axle plates: four, 80 x 85 x 8 mm, a 21 mm hole 40 up from the bottom;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one each side of each rail, centred 800 behind the rail front ends,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tops flush with the rail top. Drill the four as a stack, then weld

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with a 20 mm bar through all four holes so they line up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld all round on a flat table; check the diagonals before welding.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: diagonals equal within 3 mm; the 20 mm bar turns by hand.
